devdoc.details: Contract for managing and updating prices of Dackie, Quack, and dckUSD tokens. Inherits from Ownable to provide ownership control.

constructor.details: Constructor to initialize the contract with the operator address.

params._operator: The address of the initial operator.

getDackiePrice().details: Returns the price of Dackie token.

returns._0: The current price of Dackie token.

getQuackPrice().details: Returns the price of Quack token.

returns._0: The current price of Quack token.

getdkcUSDPrice().details: Returns the price of dckUSD token.

returns._0: The current price of dckUSD token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateDackiePrice(uint256).details: Updates the price of Dackie token. Can only be called by the operator.

params._price: The new price of Dackie token.

updateOperator(address).details: Updates the operator address. Can only be called by the owner.

params._newOperator: The address of the new operator.

updateQuackPrice(uint256).details: Updates the price of Quack token. Can only be called by the operator.

params._price: The new price of Quack token.

updatedUSDPrice(uint256).details: Updates the price of dckUSD token. Can only be called by the operator.

params._price: The new price of dckUSD token.

devdoc.title: DackieOracle
